# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 8 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 8:3 — commandments vs. commands

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "with all the commands" | Literal cum omnibus mandatis |
| LOGOS | "with all its commandments" | More formal register |
| PNEUMA | "with all of its commandments" | Same as LOGOS |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** LOGOS/PNEUMA agree: 'commandments.' This is more precisely rendered with the full form in a theological context. Adopted LOGOS.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---
